_doc: Spec 016 storage ratchet (env freeze ratchet, 2026-10-11 decision), enforced by scripts/snap-split/verify.py step 8 (Ratchet).
Every value must equal what verify.py measures at the PR head; the copy at the merge-base with staging is the ceiling.
Lower a value (remove a per-file entry at 0) in the PR that reduces it. env.members, env.header, env.storage_members and raw_imports never go up.
Per-file counts may move between files while storage_refs_total does not rise; a higher total needs a new justifications["storage_refs.total"] line.
Measured set (keys relative to snap/): every .scala file under controller/ and actors/, plus SNAPSyncController.scala, the split's move source (RATCHET_FILES, T054c).

capabilities (T054b; first entry at T055): {TraitName: {file, members, raw_imports}}. Added only by a `# capability: TraitName` PR; never removed. members only goes down (growth needs justifications["capabilities.TraitName.members"]); raw_imports is fixed when the capability is introduced and only shrinks. The capability file is the storage boundary, so it is not a storage_refs row; elsewhere `accessor.call` is not a storage reference, while `accessor.handle` (a parameterless storage-typed member) counts once.

counter (T060b): the counter version (verify.py COUNTER_VERSIONS; absent = 1). Version 2 drops the coordinators' reviewed false positives (STORAGE_NAME_ALLOW_V2) and counts `storageDone`. It only goes up, and raising it re-baselines every row, so it needs a new justifications["storage_refs.total"] line.

justifications.storage_refs.total: counter v2 (spec 016 T060b, re-baseline, no code change): the coordinators' false positives no longer count (ForceCompleteStorage, isNodeInStorage, .isStorage, replayQueuedStorage, .createStorageTask, the SNAPSyncMetrics setStorage* setters, the SyncProgressMonitor and SnapIntakeBudget counters, the maxConcurrentStorageAccounts/maxPendingStorageTasks settings, evaluateStorageTail, sampledStorageRoots, validateStorageRanges, verifyStorageRange, attachStorageConsumer: -53) and AccountRangeCoordinator's storageDone store now counts (+10: its constructor and apply parameters, body uses, the ChildFactories forwarding and the DownloadSupervisor spawn label). 678 under counter 1 = 635 under counter 2
justifications.capabilities.StateIngest.members: spec 016 T060d (D-T060-1, user decision 2026-10-12): 9 -> 12. StateIngest gains the derived stores the coordinators take: trieStore(pivot) (a pure forwarder of stateStorage.getBackingStorage, called only by the core's per-pivot cache getOrCreateMptStorage), snapProgress (the core's snapProgressStorage) and storageDone (the core's storageDoneStorage, by-name because the core builds it after the capability). Same instances, built where they are today. The healing stores (HealingFrontierStorage, BfsQueueStorage) are deferred to C-H1 (#1584)
